name: feature-flow
description: Flow/spec-based feature work: two lanes, a flow doc with an executable Harness, and receipt-backed verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route feature work through the express or flow lane.
interface.longDescription: Feature Flow routes existing-codebase feature work into the Express or Flow lane. The Flow lane records a flow doc (Spec/Plan/Harness) and gates verification on a receipt of the Harness commands plus the four git OIDs they ran against.
defaultPrompt: Implement this through the right feature-flow lane.
